title: Structural Evolution in Massive Galaxies at z ∼ 2
question: Where does star formation occur in massive (M*>1e11) star-forming galaxies at z~2 (FIR vs optical/mass size), and how will these galaxies change their size and central mass?

what.value: HST F160W Sersic structural parameters (Re, n, q, PA)
Half-mass radii from stellar mass maps for 26 of 58 galaxies

evidence.quote: For our sample, 26 of 58 massive SFGs have measurements of the half-mass radius from (cite: 2014ApJ...788...11L).
153 of 706 SMGs have robust size measurements from ALMA 0.18$''$-resolution observations (cite: 2019MNRAS.490.4956G).
We use the 3D-HST catalog including multi-wavelength photometry from ultraviolet to near-infrared and grism redshifts (cite: 2014ApJS..214...24S; 2016ApJS..225...27M)

what.value: Mass-size relations of SFGs/QGs (CANDELS/3D-HST and COSMOS-DASH)

evidence.quote: in the combined sample of the CANDELS/3D-HST survey (cite: 2014ApJ...788...28V; 2014ApJS..214...24S; 2016ApJS..225...27M) and the COSMOS-DASH survey (cite: 2019ApJ...880...57M)

recipe.method: 3D-HST catalog; z=1.9-2.6, log M*>11 from FAST SED fits, UVJ selection for SFGs
assumptions: Chabrier IMF, Bruzual & Charlot models, Calzetti attenuation, exponentially declining SFHs

recipe.goal: Image continuum at three resolutions and measure detections/flux densities
recipe.method: tclean images with different uv selection, robust and taper; S/N from intermediate-res, total flux from low-res

recipe.goal: Measure FIR sizes via visibility fitting
recipe.method: Fit elliptical/circular Gaussian and exponential disk (n=1) models to visibilities
key_parameters: Only S/N>10 sources (62) used for size discussion
assumptions: Disk model: axis ratio and PA fixed to Gaussian values

recipe.method: Compare visibility vs image flux; stack model-subtracted visibilities for compact and extended subsamples and image with taper

recipe.goal: Compare FIR size with optical, mass and Halpha sizes; correlations
recipe.method: Ratios of effective radii (16th/84th percentiles); Spearman rank tests vs galaxy properties

recipe.goal: Derive spatially resolved mass/SFR and project structural evolution
recipe.method: Deproject Sersic profiles (Abel transform), scale HST to M* and ALMA to SFR, compute M1kpc and Re after adding new stellar mass SFR*tau*beta
assumptions: beta=0.6 mass loss for Chabrier IMF; current SFR and its spatial distribution constant

evidence.quote: We detect the 870 $\mu$m continuum emission from 74 of 85 galaxies at S/N$>$5, 62 of which have S/N$>$10
The median flux density is $S_\mathrm{image}=$1.8 mJy in the range from 0.4 mJy to 6.9 mJy.
the effective radius in the FIR is smaller by a factor of 2.3$^{+1.9}_{-1.0}$ than that in the optical
the effective radius in the FIR is still by a factor of 1.9$^{+1.9}_{-0.9}$ smaller than the half-mass radius
$S_\mathrm{visibility}/S_\mathrm{image}=$0.93 in the Gaussian and $S_\mathrm{visibility}/S_\mathrm{image}=$0.98 in the disk model

answer_key.quantity: Spearman correlation of size ratio with gas fraction
Fraction reaching log M1kpc>10.5 at 300 Myr

evidence.quote: 22 ($\sim$38%) of 58 massive SFGs have a dense core with $\log (M_\mathrm{1kpc}/M_\ensuremath{\odot})>10.5$ at $\tau_\mathrm{SF}=$ 300 Myr

answer_key.quantity: Change in Re and M* in 300 Myr

evidence.quote: the effective radius is decreased, on average, by 14% in 300 Myr while the stellar mass is increased by 28%
The detection rate in the updated SFG sample increases from 87% to 94%

not_stated_but_needed: CASA version and calibration/flagging details; whether pipeline or manual
Spectral window setup and continuum bandwidth
Cell size and image size for tclean
Treatment of archival data from different projects (frequency/resolution differences)
UVMULTIFIT starting values, bounds and fit procedure details
Number of mock simulations processing details; SED fitting constraints on tau and age
Exact SFR uncertainty and 870 um gas-mass conversion parameters used

score_reason: Public data and tables with sizes, with partially specified imaging and fitting, but calibration and fit details are missing and external HST inputs are required.
